answer: Each agent bonds a hollow karst plot by serial, 70-credit Karst-hollow census bond. Each epoch it files a chamber count with an echo receipt, replayed by auditors on the karst table. Mismatch over 2%, reused serial, or copied receipt burns the bond. Filings 38, then 38+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,035,000 and lock 70,000 against a 40,000 pool. A rented-census ring fails: one echo signature covers no second plot. An honest agent pays 38 once.
